script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: A New Leaf

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

ALICE (mid 30s, thoughtful) sits at a corner table, gazing at her laptop. She wears a professional blazer over a blouse and jeans. She types furiously, taking breaks to sip her coffee.

WAITER (30s, friendly) approaches.

WAITER
(cheerfully)
Another cup of joe, Alice?

ALICE
(smiling)
Yes, please.

waiter exits

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Alice receives an email notification. She reads it, looks stunned. She packs up her things and leaves the coffee shop.

EXT. PARK - DAY

Alice sits on a bench, surrounded by autumn leaves. She reads the email again, then bursts into tears.

ALICE
(whispering to herself)
They're letting me go.

Suddenly, a hand lands gently on her shoulder.

MAX (early 40s, kind) sits down next to her.

MAX
(gently)
Hey, are you okay?

ALICE
(sniffling)
I've lost my job.

MAX
(sighs)
I'm sorry to hear that.

INT. ALICE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Alice sits in her living room, surrounded by stacks of bills and resumés. She looks defeated.

MAX (off screen)
Alice, I've got an idea.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

Max enters Alice's kitchen with a large basket of fruits and vegetables.

MAX
I want to help you start a business. A farm stand.

ALICE
(skeptical)
A farm stand? I don't even know the first thing about farming.

MAX
(smiling)
That's why I'm here. I'll teach you everything you need to know.

EXT. ABANDONED PLOT - DAY

Max and Alice work side by side, preparing the ground for planting.

MAX
Seeing you struggle in your career made me realize that maybe it's time for a change for both of us.

ALICE
(smiling)
You mean it?

MAX
Absolutely.

INT. ALICE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Alice sits in her living room, surrounded by seeds and seedlings. She looks determined.

INT. COMMUNITY GARDEN - DAY

Alice and Max work together, planting flowers and vegetables. They exchange stories and laughs.

INT. FARM STAND - DAY

Max and Alice stand behind their farm stand, selling their produce to customers. Alice looks proud and happy.

CUSTOMER
(smiling)
This is the best tomato I've ever had!

ALICE
(beaming)
Thank you! We take great care in growing them.

MAX
(to Alice)
You're a natural.

EXT. FARM STAND - SUNSET

Max and Alice watch the sunset, surrounded by their produce and customers.

MAX
I'm glad we made this change together.

ALICE
Me too. I couldn't have done it without you.

They share a moment of understanding and connection.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
